simple.meaning: מַכָּה (makkâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication, a wound ; figuratively, carnage , also pestilence.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 48 times across Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 12 more, beginning at Leviticus 26:21. Its contexts include family, covenant, Torah, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַכָּה (H4347).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H4347. makkah or makkeh מַכָּה noun feminine blow, wound, slaughter ; — absolute ׳מ 1Sam 4:8 +; construct מַכַּת Isa 10:26 +; suffix מַכָּתִי Jer 10:19 ; 15:18 , etc.; **plural מַכִּי֥֥ 2Kin 8:29 = 9:15 2Chr 22:6 ; מַכּוֺת absolute Zech 13:6 +, construct,' etc.; plural מַכּוֺת absolute 2Kin 8:29 +; construct Deut 29:21 +; suffix מַכֹּתְךָ 28:59 , מַכּוֺתַיִךְ Jer 30:17 , etc.; — 1. a. blow, stripe , literally of scourging, chastising Deut 25:3 ; Prov 20:30 (|| מֶּצַע חַבֻּרוֺת ); חֶרֶב מַכַּת Est 9:5 (as accusative of congnate meaning with verb). b. beating, scourging , figurative of defeat of Midian Isa 10:26 (|| שׁוֺט עוֺרֵר ). c. often wound 1Kin 22:35 ; 2Kin 8:29 ; 9:15 2Chr 22:6 (read ׳מִןהַֿמּ ), Zech 13:6 ( יָדֶיךָ בֵּין ); symbolic of violence Jer 6:7 (+ חֳלִי ); טְרִיָּה וּמַכָּה וְחַבּוּרָה מֶּצַע Isa 1:6 (of Judah, under figure of maltreated man), compare Micah 1:9 אֲנוּשָׁה׳מ ), Nahum 3:19 (|| שֶׁבֶר ; of Nineveh), especially in Jeremiah (of Judah): Jer 10:19 ; 14:17 ; 30:12 (all + נַחֲלָה severe ; || שֶׁבֶר ), 15:18 ( ׳מ אֲנוּשָׁה ), 19:8 ; Jeremiah 47:17; 50:13 , as accusative of congnate meaning with verb 30:14 , with verb רָפָא heal 30:17 ; also מ ׳מַחַץ Isa 30:26 (|| שֶׁבֶר ); of wounds made by ׳י s arrows Psa 64:8 . 2 = slaughter 1Sam 4:10 ; 14:30 , usually as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with הִכָּה Josh 10:20 ; 1Sam 6:19 ; 14:14 ; 19:8 ; 23:5 ; 1Kin 20:21 ; 2Chr 13:17 . 3 = defeat , as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with הִכָּה Josh 10:10 ; Joshua 11:33; 15:8 ; 2Chr 28:5 ; = conquest (of ׳י ) Isa 14:6 . 4 plague , especially disease, as punishment (of ׳י ), 1Sam 4:8 ; Deut 28:59 (3 t. in verse) (|| חֳלִי ), 28:61 (|| id. ), 29:21 (|| תַּחֲלֻאִים ), Lev 26:21 (H), as accusative of congnate meaning with verb Num 11:33 . — מַכּוֺת 2Chr 2:9 read מַכֹּלֶת (see אכל ) as || 1 Kings 5:25, so ᵑ9 ᵐ5 Be Öttli and Th 1Ki 5:25 .
